title: FAIR Data Schema Measurement Scales CV
description: A controlled vocabulary for categorizing measurement scales (nominal, ordinal, interval, ratio, absolute, relative). Each entry provides a canonical URI for use in 'fair:measurementScaleRef'.

nominal.description: Unordered categorical scale. Values are distinct names or categories without inherent order.

ordinal.description: Ordered categorical scale. Values have a defined rank order, but distances between ranks are not equal or quantifiable.

interval.description: Quantitative scale with equal intervals between values, but an arbitrary or relative zero point.

ratio.description: Quantitative scale with equal intervals and an absolute zero point, allowing ratio comparisons.

absolute.description: Discrete integer count of items, entities, or events.

relative.description: Proportions, percentages, growth rates, or index numbers relative to a baseline.
